An '''Ortolan village''' was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lenico IV]] some time around [[3678 BBY]]. That year, the [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] [[Exal Kressh]] traveled to the planet and was forced to destroy the village and slaughter its harmless [[Ortolan/Legends|Ortolan]] population.
